script_text: Pisces, Neptune's water sign, this week your destiny gets audited. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun in Sagittarius lights your 10th House of career and sextiles Neptune in your 2nd House, turning intuition into real income. Tuesday is heavy because the Full Moon in your 4th House squares Mars in your 6th House, forcing home and work demands to collide. Midweek, that Full Moon becomes your turning point, opposing the Sun and exposing what needs balance. Thursday through Sunday, Mercury and Venus in Scorpio activate your 9th House, deepening romance, negotiations, and travel ideas. Friday's Moon in Cancer trines Venus, making affection feel fated. Wednesday is your power day because the Full Moon clarifies your public path. Tuesday is the worst day because Mars pressures your daily grind and your routine. Protect your energy by writing one realistic budget line before midnight. Follow for daily updates.
